intermediate_turns.sql: SELECT * FROM undergoes AS T1 JOIN patient AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.SSN JOIN stay AS T3 ON T1.Stay  =  T3.StayID WHERE T3.room  =  111

answer: SELECT T1.title ,  T3.name FROM course AS T1 JOIN teaches AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id JOIN instructor AS T3 ON T2.id  =  T3.id WHERE YEAR  =  2008 ORDER BY T1.title

CREATE TABLE `classroom` (
  `building` TEXT,
  `room_number` TEXT,
  `capacity` NUMBER,
  PRIMARY KEY (`building`)
);

CREATE TABLE `department` (
  `dept_name` TEXT,
  `building` TEXT,
  `budget` NUMBER,
  PRIMARY KEY (`dept_name`)
);

CREATE TABLE `course` (
  `course_id` TEXT,
  `title` TEXT,
  `dept_name` TEXT REFERENCES `department`(`dept_name`),
  `credits` NUMBER,
  PRIMARY KEY (`course_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `instructor` (
  `ID` TEXT,
  `name` TEXT,
  `dept_name` TEXT REFERENCES `department`(`dept_name`),
  `salary` NUMBER,
  PRIMARY KEY (`ID`)
);

CREATE TABLE `section` (
  `course_id` TEXT REFERENCES `course`(`course_id`),
  `sec_id` TEXT,
  `semester` TEXT,
  `year` NUMBER,
  `building` TEXT REFERENCES `classroom`(`building`),
  `room_number` TEXT REFERENCES `classroom`(`room_number`),
  `time_slot_id` TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (`course_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `teaches` (
  `ID` TEXT REFERENCES `instructor`(`ID`),
  `course_id` TEXT REFERENCES `section`(`course_id`),
  `sec_id` TEXT REFERENCES `section`(`sec_id`),
  `semester` TEXT REFERENCES `section`(`semester`),
  `year` NUMBER REFERENCES `section`(`year`),
  PRIMARY KEY (`ID`)
);

CREATE TABLE `student` (
  `ID` TEXT,
  `name` TEXT,
  `dept_name` TEXT REFERENCES `department`(`dept_name`),
  `tot_cred` NUMBER,
  PRIMARY KEY (`ID`)
);

CREATE TABLE `takes` (
  `ID` TEXT REFERENCES `student`(`ID`),
  `course_id` TEXT REFERENCES `section`(`course_id`),
  `sec_id` TEXT REFERENCES `section`(`sec_id`),
  `semester` TEXT REFERENCES `section`(`semester`),
  `year` NUMBER REFERENCES `section`(`year`),
  `grade` TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (`ID`)
);

CREATE TABLE `advisor` (
  `s_ID` TEXT REFERENCES `student`(`ID`),
  `i_ID` TEXT REFERENCES `instructor`(`ID`),
  PRIMARY KEY (`s_ID`)
);

CREATE TABLE `time_slot` (
  `time_slot_id` TEXT,
  `day` TEXT,
  `start_hr` NUMBER,
  `start_min` NUMBER,
  `end_hr` NUMBER,
  `end_min` NUMBER,
  PRIMARY KEY (`time_slot_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `prereq` (
  `course_id` TEXT REFERENCES `course`(`course_id`),
  `prereq_id` TEXT REFERENCES `course`(`course_id`),
  PRIMARY KEY (`course_id`)
);

answer: SELECT count(*) FROM professor AS T1 JOIN department AS T2 ON T1.dept_code  =  T2.dept_code WHERE T2.dept_name  =  'Accounting' OR T2.dept_name  =  'Biology'

Systems'

CREATE TABLE `regions` (
  `REGION_ID` NUMBER,
  `REGION_NAME` TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (`REGION_ID`)
);

CREATE TABLE `countries` (
  `COUNTRY_ID` TEXT,
  `COUNTRY_NAME` TEXT,
  `REGION_ID` NUMBER REFERENCES `regions`(`REGION_ID`),
  PRIMARY KEY (`COUNTRY_ID`)
);

CREATE TABLE `departments` (
  `DEPARTMENT_ID` NUMBER,
  `DEPARTMENT_NAME` TEXT,
  `MANAGER_ID` NUMBER,
  `LOCATION_ID` NUMBER,
  PRIMARY KEY (`DEPARTMENT_ID`)
);

CREATE TABLE `jobs` (
  `JOB_ID` TEXT,
  `JOB_TITLE` TEXT,
  `MIN_SALARY` NUMBER,
  `MAX_SALARY` NUMBER,
  PRIMARY KEY (`JOB_ID`)
);

CREATE TABLE `employees` (
  `EMPLOYEE_ID` NUMBER,
  `FIRST_NAME` TEXT,
  `LAST_NAME` TEXT,
  `EMAIL` TEXT,
  `PHONE_NUMBER` TEXT,
  `HIRE_DATE` TIME,
  `JOB_ID` TEXT REFERENCES `jobs`(`JOB_ID`),
  `SALARY` NUMBER,
  `COMMISSION_PCT` NUMBER,
  `MANAGER_ID` NUMBER,
  `DEPARTMENT_ID` NUMBER REFERENCES `departments`(`DEPARTMENT_ID`),
  PRIMARY KEY (`EMPLOYEE_ID`)
);

CREATE TABLE `job_history` (
  `EMPLOYEE_ID` NUMBER REFERENCES `employees`(`EMPLOYEE_ID`),
  `START_DATE` TIME,
  `END_DATE` TIME,
  `JOB_ID` TEXT REFERENCES `jobs`(`JOB_ID`),
  `DEPARTMENT_ID` NUMBER REFERENCES `departments`(`DEPARTMENT_ID`),
  PRIMARY KEY (`EMPLOYEE_ID`)
);

CREATE TABLE `locations` (
  `LOCATION_ID` NUMBER,
  `STREET_ADDRESS` TEXT,
  `POSTAL_CODE` TEXT,
  `CITY` TEXT,
  `STATE_PROVINCE` TEXT,
  `COUNTRY_ID` TEXT REFERENCES `countries`(`COUNTRY_ID`),
  PRIMARY KEY (`LOCATION_ID`)
);

Question:
what are the employee ids and job titles for employees in department 80?
answer: SELECT T1.employee_id ,  T2.job_title FROM employees AS T1 JOIN jobs AS T2 ON T1.job_id  =  T2.job_id WHERE T1.department_id = 80

Database Schema:
CREATE TABLE `Ref_Document_Types` (
  `Document_Type_Code` TEXT,
  `Document_Type_Name` TEXT,
  `Document_Type_Description` TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Document_Type_Code`)
);

CREATE TABLE `Ref_Calendar` (
  `Calendar_Date` TIME,
  `Day_Number` NUMBER,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Calendar_Date`)
);

CREATE TABLE `Ref_Locations` (
  `Location_Code` TEXT,
  `Location_Name` TEXT,
  `Location_Description` TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Location_Code`)
);

CREATE TABLE `Roles` (
  `Role_Code` TEXT,
  `Role_Name` TEXT,
  `Role_Description` TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Role_Code`)
);

CREATE TABLE `All_Documents` (
  `Document_ID` NUMBER,
  `Date_Stored` TIME REFERENCES `Ref_Calendar`(`Calendar_Date`),
  `Document_Type_Code` TEXT REFERENCES `Ref_Document_Types`(`Document_Type_Code`),
  `Document_Name` TEXT,
  `Document_Description` TEXT,
  `Other_Details` TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Document_ID`)
);

CREATE TABLE `Employees` (
  `Employee_ID` NUMBER,
  `Role_Code` TEXT REFERENCES `Roles`(`Role_Code`),
  `Employee_Name` TEXT,
  `Gender_MFU` TEXT,
  `Date_of_Birth` TIME,
  `Other_Details` TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Employee_ID`)
);

CREATE TABLE `Document_Locations` (
  `Document_ID` NUMBER REFERENCES `All_Documents`(`Document_ID`),
  `Location_Code` TEXT REFERENCES `Ref_Locations`(`Location_Code`),
  `Date_in_Location_From` TIME REFERENCES `Ref_Calendar`(`Calendar_Date`),
  `Date_in_Locaton_To` TIME REFERENCES `Ref_Calendar`(`Calendar_Date`),
  PRIMARY KEY (`Document_ID`)
);

CREATE TABLE `Documents_to_be_Destroyed` (
  `Document_ID` NUMBER REFERENCES `All_Documents`(`Document_ID`),
  `Destruction_Authorised_by_Employee_ID` NUMBER REFERENCES `Employees`(`Employee_ID`),
  `Destroyed_by_Employee_ID` NUMBER REFERENCES `Employees`(`Employee_ID`),
  `Planned_Destruction_Date` TIME REFERENCES `Ref_Calendar`(`Calendar_Date`),
  `Actual_Destruction_Date` TIME REFERENCES `Ref_Calendar`(`Calendar_Date`),
  `Other_Details` TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Document_ID`)
);

intermediate_turns.sql: SELECT T2.firstname ,  T2.lastname FROM Performance AS T1 JOIN Band AS T2 ON T1.bandmate  =  T2.id JOIN Songs AS T3 ON T3.SongId  =  T1.SongId WHERE T3.Title  =  "Der Kapitan"

intermediate_turns.question: Who plays in the back stage position? Show first and last names.

intermediate_turns.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.defensive_work_rate = "high"

intermediate_turns.question: How about players whose attacking work rate is high?
intermediate_turns.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.defensive_work_rate = "high" AND T2.attacking_work_rate = "high"

intermediate_turns.question: Tell me the names of all players who have a crossing score higher than 90 and prefer their right foot.
intermediate_turns.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.crossing  >  90 AND T2.preferred_foot  =  "right"

intermediate_turns.sql: SELECT T1.account_id ,  T2.account_name FROM Financial_transactions AS T1 JOIN Accounts AS T2 ON T1.account_id  =  T2.account_id

intermediate_turns.question: Also count the number of transactions for each of them.
intermediate_turns.sql: SELECT T1.account_id ,  T2.account_name , count(*) FROM Financial_transactions AS T1 JOIN Accounts AS T2 ON T1.account_id  =  T2.account_id GROUP BY T1.account_id

intermediate_turns.question: Which of them have at least 4 transactions?
intermediate_turns.sql: SELECT T1.account_id ,  T2.account_name FROM Financial_transactions AS T1 JOIN Accounts AS T2 ON T1.account_id  =  T2.account_id GROUP BY T1.account_id HAVING count(*)  >=  4

  PRIMARY KEY (`City_ID`)

  `Match_ID` NUMBER,
  `Date` TEXT,
  `Venue` TEXT,
  `Score` TEXT,
  `Result` TEXT,
  `Competition` TEXT,

);

Question:
Give me a list of cities whose temperature in March is lower than that in July or higher than that in Oct?
answer: SELECT T1.city FROM city AS T1 JOIN temperature AS T2 ON T1.city_id  =  T2.city_id WHERE T2.Mar  <  T2.Jul OR T2.Mar  >  T2.Oct

Question:
In 2014, what are the id and rank of the team that has the largest average number of attendance?
answer: SELECT T2.team_id ,  T2.rank FROM home_game AS T1 JOIN team AS T2 ON T1.team_id  =  T2.team_id WHERE T1.year  =  2014 GROUP BY T1.team_id ORDER BY avg(T1.attendance) DESC LIMIT 1;

Which 3 players won the most player awards? List their full name and id.
answer: SELECT T1.name_first ,  T1.name_last ,  T1.player_id FROM player AS T1 JOIN player_award AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.player_id GROUP BY T1.player_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 3;

CREATE TABLE `Customers` (
  `Customer_ID` NUMBER,
  `Customer_Details` TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Customer_ID`)
);

CREATE TABLE `Customer_Policies` (
  `Policy_ID` NUMBER,
  `Customer_ID` NUMBER REFERENCES `Customers`(`Customer_ID`),
  `Policy_Type_Code` TEXT,
  `Start_Date` TIME,
  `End_Date` TIME,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Policy_ID`)
);

CREATE TABLE `Claims` (
  `Claim_ID` NUMBER,
  `Policy_ID` NUMBER REFERENCES `Customer_Policies`(`Policy_ID`),
  `Date_Claim_Made` TIME,
  `Date_Claim_Settled` TIME,
  `Amount_Claimed` NUMBER,
  `Amount_Settled` NUMBER,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Claim_ID`)
);

CREATE TABLE `Settlements` (
  `Settlement_ID` NUMBER,
  `Claim_ID` NUMBER REFERENCES `Claims`(`Claim_ID`),
  `Date_Claim_Made` TIME,
  `Date_Claim_Settled` TIME,
  `Amount_Claimed` NUMBER,
  `Amount_Settled` NUMBER,
  `Customer_Policy_ID` NUMBER,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Settlement_ID`)
);

CREATE TABLE `Payments` (
  `Payment_ID` NUMBER,
  `Settlement_ID` NUMBER REFERENCES `Settlements`(`Settlement_ID`),
  `Payment_Method_Code` TEXT,
  `Date_Payment_Made` TIME,
  `Amount_Payment` NUMBER,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Payment_ID`)
);

Question:

answer: SELECT T1.customer_details ,  T1.customer_id FROM Customers AS T1 JOIN Customer_Policies AS T2 ON T1.Customer_id  =  T2.Customer_id GROUP BY T1.customer_id HAVING count(*)  >  1
